errors.text: The proposed refractory-element addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of intermediate-temperature aging in as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
It misses the target non-monotonic ductile-brittle-ductile transition and the distinct behavior near 600°C and 750°C.
The proposed grain-boundary segregation/carbide mechanism conflicts with the target L12 ordering, planar slip, and jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary mechanism.
No supporting prior evidence is cited.
The claimed 'specific ratio' of Mo and W is never specified, making the intervention insufficiently testable.
Carbide precipitation is asserted without defining carbon content or carbide-forming thermodynamic and kinetic conditions.
